assets.alt: Four fictional adult women sit in an affectionate diagonal cluster above Marina Bay and the Helix Bridge. A blonde rests against a Black woman's clothed lap while two dark-haired women lean in. Short red and white looks, rainbow platforms, rainbow ankle boots and silver knee-high boots frame the high-oblique view.

Four fictional adult women gather in a close affectionate composition before Jewel Changi's Rain Vortex. A Black woman and blonde stand beside a seated dark-haired woman while a brunette leans in. Singapore flag panels, rainbow hosiery and scorpion, star and GRD tattoos remain visible.

Four fictional adult women share a seated handclasp and close side hugs above Byblos harbor and its stone ramparts. Short burgundy, white, red and green Lebanon-inspired looks are paired with towering burgundy boots, rainbow pumps, green boots and rainbow sandals.
